@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, with the message "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant." Both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

The channel only records one thing about the guard in that window: at 10:42 they were "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Mateo's 10:44 message says six trucks were waiting at the east gate. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. Your 11:08 message says both lanes were working as of 11:07. The channel doesn't say what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03 beyond that clipboard note, so anything more would need the guard or Vantorre's site team.
